attribute_secret: highest-entropy eligible exact low-cardinality feature; otherwise a four-quantile derived attribute
reconstruction_secret: highest-cardinality numeric feature with at least three distinct nonmissing values; exact categorical fallback when a dataset has no numeric feature
attack_training_data: disjoint reference split with known secrets
baseline: same auxiliary records, candidate-known features, label, and exact summaries but no target-model response curve
uncertainty: paired percentile bootstrap with 10000 fixed-seed resamples plus exact one-sided McNemar test for attribute correctness
claim_boundary: attribute inference and one-feature numeric or categorical reconstruction; not full-row reconstruction
